BugUpdateIn.title: BugUpdateIn
BugUpdateIn.description:
Only the fields that are sent change. A field that is sent as null is cleared where that makes sense
(component, environment, release, assignee) and is a 422 otherwise.

CaseUpdateIn.title: CaseUpdateIn
CaseUpdateIn.description: Only the fields that are sent change. A case moves to another suite of the same project with `suite_id`.

invite_url.title: Invite Url
invite_url.description: Shown once. Send it yourself; no email is sent (D-011).

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Workspace address, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens

key.title: Key
key.description: 2 to 6 letters; stored in capitals and used in bug ids such as WEB-42

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 10 characters with a letter and a number

SavedViewFilters.title: SavedViewFilters
SavedViewFilters.description:
The stored filter set: the same keys as the list endpoint, plus a version number. Unknown keys are a 422.
When a stored filter changes meaning, add version 2 to the Literal and a reader that upgrades version 1 rows.

StepIn.title: StepIn
StepIn.description: A step. Send the `id` of an existing step to keep it when steps are reordered; steps without one get a new id.

SuiteUpdateIn.title: SuiteUpdateIn
SuiteUpdateIn.description: Only the fields that are sent change. `component_id: null` clears the component.
